section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single study (Study X) examining the relationship between early positive emotional experiences, self-compassion, body appreciation, and eating psychopathology in 490 women. The study used path analysis to test a mediation model, finding that self-compassion and body appreciation fully mediated the relationship between early emotional memories and disordered eating, accounting for 49% of eating psychopathology variance. The research was conducted via an Internet-based survey with self-report measures.
